html:
The Giya were an Aboriginal Australian people of the central Queensland coast, around today's Bowen and Proserpine.

Little is recorded about them. Their neighbours were the Biri inland, the Yuwibara to the south around Mackay and the Yangga to the west. Bowen, founded at Port Denison in 1861, was the first European settlement in north Queensland, and the Giya were among the first peoples of the north to face the frontier.
sum: The Giya were an Aboriginal Australian people of the central Queensland coast, around today's Bowen and Proserpine.
